title: Replace the project proxy wrapper with Qt's QML SortFilterProxyModel
scope: Drawer-only Qt QML proxy migration implemented and verified. User confirmed the change works and requested ticket closure and a commit on 2026-11-03.
request: Use Qt's SortFilterProxyModel exposed to QML instead of the project's custom C++ SortFilterProxyModel.
expected: The drawer list catalog uses Qt's QML proxy type with explicit sort/filter configuration. The redundant project wrapper and its build/QML registration are removed without changing list selection or shopping behavior.
implementation_notes: Inspect the API in the supported Qt kits and use QtQml.Models sorters/filters to express the existing behavior directly; follow KISS and avoid another wrapper or generic filtering framework.

Preserve filtering of checked catalog entries and name sorting, including case, locale, equal-name ordering and the synthetic catalog entry. Establish the original behavior before choosing equivalent role/value and sorter settings.
Preserve active-list UUID binding, fresh-install default display, catalog reload on drawer opening, create/rename/delete/Undo and selection restoration after restart.
Keep this scoped to the drawer catalog proxy; preserve the user's shopping order, checked-item stack and Reset behavior.
Resolve the identical Qt/project type names explicitly during migration. Remove the obsolete C++ files, QML registration and CMake source references once the replacement is wired in.
Verify module import/deployment on Windows and Android and account for the documented preview status when recording supported versions. Coordinate only necessary build edits with DEV-004.
acceptance_criteria: Use Qt's QML SortFilterProxyModel for the drawer catalog and remove the project wrapper and stale build/QML references.
Add or strengthen automated characterization of filtering, sorting and dynamic catalog changes before migration; the same observable behavior must pass with the replacement.
Existing fresh/default selection, UUID, catalog edit/Undo and restart tests pass, with shopping contents/order and unfinished edits preserved.
Run tools/verify-windows.ps1 and appropriate native Android selector/catalog/deployment checks with isolated data.
Document the chosen Qt API/version and any material behavior differences; keep unrelated refactoring and app fixes separate.
evidence: User backlog request on 2026-11-01 to replace the project's proxy with the Qt QML-exposed type.
baseline_evidence: View.qml creates the project SortFilterProxyModel over a read-only Model and uses it for the Lists selector, with name as textRole and id as valueRole.
sortfilterproxymodel.cpp configures Qt::CheckStateRole filtering with ^false$ and ascending column-0 sorting; its remaining parser-status hook is empty.
CMakeLists.txt compiles sortfilterproxymodel.h/.cpp into the QShopper QML module.

Qt documentation checked on 2026-11-01 exposes SortFilterProxyModel through QtQml.Models since Qt 6.10. The current Qt 6.12 documentation labels the API technology preview. No application defect is claimed.

changes: Use Models.SortFilterProxyModel, ValueFilter checked=false and RoleSorter name in View.qml with explicit module alias.
Use model property to retain Qt 6.10/6.11 API compatibility while validating its alias in Qt 6.12; no added compatibility wrapper.
Remove sortfilterproxymodel.cpp/.h and CMake source registration; declare QtQml.Models dependency.
Add permanent actual-drawer characterization and a test-only scoped locale exchange helper; preserve existing selection, user-flow and platform tests.
Update agent guidance, coding guide and test/Android documentation to reflect the replacement.

characterization.coverage: Actual drawer proxy/selector; unchecked filtering; case-sensitive lexical names including numbers/accents under C/fi_FI/sv_SE; stable duplicate UUIDs; synthetic catalog entry; live check/uncheck/rename/delete/Undo; retained active UUID and shopping contents.
characterization.kind: Behavior-preserving migration characterization, not an application bug fix; no artificial failing-before test.

android_build.deployment: QtQml.Models declared in host/Android qmldir; QmlModels library and Models plugin present in APK; successful real app launches and native catalog workflows.

analyzers.scope: Changed tests/test_ui.cpp under existing clang-tidy/Clazy profiles; production C++ only deleted.

api.source_property: model: Qt 6.10/6.11 documented name, retained alias in Qt 6.12 (deprecated on C++ side). Keep stated minimum instead of introducing a version branch/wrapper.
api.status: Technology preview; recheck API when upgrading Qt.
api.tested: Qt 6.12.0 MSVC x64 and Android x86_64; Qt 6.10/6.11 runtime and ARM64 not retested.

verification.warnings: Existing DEV-001 PopupList contentWidth override diagnostic remains. Android scanner reports historical QDynamics/Components/Shop.timer imports from old generated trees; all 55 current project QML/template files have none. No binding-loop or test failures.

implementation.preserved: Catalog source remains read-only with drawer-open reload. UUID selection, synthetic lists entry, duplicate ordering, existing shopping order, drafts and storage schema are preserved.
implementation.commit: Included with the source, characterization tests and documentation in this ticket's commit; see Git history.

resolution.summary: Use QtQml.Models SortFilterProxyModel with ValueFilter checked=false and RoleSorter name; remove the project C++ wrapper and source registration. Filtering/order, synthetic entry, live catalog changes, UUID selection and restart behavior preserved.
resolution.user_acceptance: 2026-11-03: Change works, close ticket and commit changes.
resolution.verification: Recorded in implementation.verification: 308 Windows records, 12 native Windows records, 38 native Android checks, analyzers and formatting pass.
resolution.remaining: None in the selected migration. Existing DEV-001/DEV-008 and untested kit/platform limits stay separate.
